title: A namespace's services and workloads, live
summary: The services of a namespace and the signals that say how they serve (traffic, errors, latency), the workloads and pods that run them and what they use against what they may (CPU, memory, volumes, nodes), what changes them (rollouts) and what they say (events, logs).

concepts.label: Service
concepts.description: What clients call; its signals are measured per request (RED: rate, errors, duration).

children.label: Latency quantile
children.description: p50 and p99 of request duration, ms, from a histogram.

facts.text: histogram_quantile computes a quantile from a histogram's buckets by linear interpolation within the bucket that holds it.

children.label: Usual band
children.description: The rolling median of the 30 minutes before ± k × 1.4826 × MAD; points outside it are noted.

children.label: Same time yesterday
children.description: The seasonal baseline: the series 24 h earlier (PromQL offset 1d).

concepts.label: Workload
concepts.description: A Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet or Job and its pods.

children.label: Pod
children.description: A running instance: its node, phase, restarts, why it last stopped.

children.label: Resource requests and limits
children.description: What the scheduler reserves (request) and what the kernel enforces (limit): CPU is throttled at its limit, memory is OOM-killed.

facts.text: A container that exceeds its memory limit is terminated (OOMKilled); one that reaches its CPU limit is throttled.

children.label: Forecast to the limit
children.description: Holt's linear exponential smoothing of usage since the last drop; when it reaches the limit, with a rough 90% range.

children.label: Rollout
children.description: A new revision of a Deployment (a ReplicaSet); a rollback reuses an old one.

concepts.label: Node
concepts.description: The machine pods run on; its CPU and memory against what it can allocate.

concepts.label: Volume
concepts.description: A PersistentVolumeClaim: used bytes against capacity (kubelet volume stats).

concepts.label: Signals from the cluster
concepts.description: Kubernetes events (scheduling, probes, back-offs; kept an hour by default) and log lines from Loki.
